name: dither-image
title: Dither image
description: Any image dithered to a preset (ink, duotone, newsprint, gameboy, riso) or your own palette, resolving from coarse to fine.

name: image-compare
title: Image compare
description: A draggable, keyboard-accessible before and after slider between a dithered image and the original or another dither.

name: scroll-reveal-image
title: Scroll reveal image
description: An image that sharpens from coarse dithered blocks to the full photo as it scrolls into view.

name: dithered-logo
title: Dithered logo
description: An SVG or PNG logo redrawn on a pixel grid with exact edges, a dithered fill and an optional shimmer or scan line.

name: logo-marquee
title: Logo marquee
description: A looping row or still wall of logos in one dithered treatment, with soft or dithered edge fades.
